source.spec: Concept proposal 'Video plugin: three concept directions' (2026-11-17), direction C Previz-to-Final, release 1 (free core)
source.build_pattern: Domain plugin. Orchestrator skill (context: fork) gates the brief; deterministic stdlib tools time beats, compile a seekable HTML animatic, render frame-exact with Playwright, lint, build a provider-neutral upgrade manifest and conform with ffmpeg + loudness QC. Generation MCPs are optional adapters behind a per-shot quote and an explicit yes.
source.distinct_from: engineering/demo-video (screenshot walkthroughs); marketing-skill/video-content-strategist (channel strategy and scripts); marketing-skill/cinematic-shot-prompting (camera prompts for one generated clip); markdown-html md-slides (presentations). Independent of Claude Motion, HyperFrames and Remotion: no code from them.
